just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on C in Nowruz-e Khara. The line peaks at F4 (333.1 Hz) at 0:07.7. It closes on C4, not the tonic (D3 → Fk4 → Eb4 → D4 → C4 → C4).
